QUOTE: By default every field is therefore named `private_<name>`. Code outside the library that writes `ctx->state` gets a compile error, and code that writes `ctx->MBEDTLS_PRIVATE(state)` compiles to `private_state`.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer explains the compile-time enforcement via renaming fields to `private_<name>`, so the member name is broken. Layout hiding is not the mechanism, and the answer shows the fields remain declared and accessible under the mangled name.
